stages.headline: Arrange in increasing order: 5 023, 5 302, 5 032, 5 203.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. All are four-digit and start with 5. 2. Compare hundreds 0, 3, 0, 2, then tens. 3. 5 023 < 5 032 < 5 203 < 5 302.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. All are four-digit and start with 5. 2. Compare hundreds 0, 3, 0, 2, then tens. 3. 5 023 < 5 032 < 5 203 < 5 302.
stages.customInstructions: The order must be 5023, 5032, 5203, 5302; commas instead of < are fine.

stages.headline: Which digits can replace * so that 7*5 > 785? List all of them.
stages.headlineEnglish: Which digits can replace * so that 7*5 > 785? List all of them.
stages.problemText: Which digits can replace * so that 7*5 > 785? List all of them.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. 7*5 must exceed 785. 2. * = 8 gives 785, not greater. 3. Only * = 9 works (795 > 785).
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. 7*5 must exceed 785. 2. * = 8 gives 785, not greater. 3. Only * = 9 works (795 > 785).

stages.headline: Write all natural numbers x with 47 < x < 52.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write all natural numbers x with 47 < x < 52.
stages.problemText: Write all natural numbers x with 47 < x < 52.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. x is above 47 and below 52. 2. x = 48, 49, 50, 51.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. x is above 47 and below 52. 2. x = 48, 49, 50, 51.
